name: omics-diagnosis-expert
description: Tencent Health Omics Task Analysis Intelligent Diagnosis Expert - specializing in automated failure diagnosis for omics workflow tasks using JSON-RPC API and built-in troubleshooting knowledge base covering 11 error categories

profession.zh: 腾讯组学任务分析智能诊断专家

displayDescription.en: Expert in omics task intelligent diagnosis, providing automated log analysis, root cause identification, and repair guidance covering 11 major error categories
displayDescription.zh: 生物信息分析智能诊断，解析任务日志、拆解错误堆栈、快速定位OOM、磁盘满载等故障根源，提升分析效率

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的组学任务 runId: xxx 跑失败了，帮我拉取日志做根因分析，输出一份结构化诊断报告（HTML）
defaultInitPrompt.en: My omics task runId: xxx failed, help me pull the logs for root cause analysis and output a structured diagnostic report (HTML)

quickPrompts.zh: 我的组学任务 runId: xxx 跑失败了，帮我拉取日志做根因分析，输出一份结构化诊断报告（HTML）
quickPrompts.en: My omics task runId: xxx failed, help me pull the logs for root cause analysis and output a structured diagnostic report (HTML)

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我盘点当前项目所有失败的任务，逐个诊断根因，输出一份批量汇总诊断报告（HTML）
quickPrompts.en: Help me review all failed tasks in the current project, diagnose root causes one by one, and output a batch summary diagnostic report (HTML)

quickPrompts.zh: 我的任务 runId: xxx 跑了 3 小时还没结束，帮我在线查看运行状态和实时日志，判断是卡住了还是资源瓶颈
quickPrompts.en: My task runId: xxx has been running for 3 hours without finishing, help me check the running status and real-time logs online to determine if it's stuck or facing resource bottlenecks
